question.text: Mandatory KYC document for ALL PMS investors is:

answer.text: Aadhaar is optional in all cases

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 107-108 make PAN card mandatory for all PMS investors to complete KYC. The Trap: Driving license and passport are acceptable identity proofs but PAN is specifically required for PMS KYC. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 107-108.
